question: Can unchanged data-machine-v1 instructions execute one-variable substitution, active-hypothesis and type checks, and a fixed-depth proof stack for a frozen pre-parsed toy Metamath database?
level: Research program calibration; no stable language or machine authority change
authority: Adva checker.adva performs label dispatch, stack operations, substitution construction, type and active-label checks, and token comparison. Python authors/encodes fixtures and supervises independent checks; it is not called by the Adva runtime.
trusted_inputs: The fixed correspondence between database.mm and the assertion/hypothesis table embedded in checker.adva is manually audited, not established by a native .mm parser
The inherited Rust data-machine-v1 implementation and its source-bound profile
No disjoint-variable restrictions, essential hypotheses, compressed proofs, arbitrary databases or multiple mandatory variables are admitted

language_audit.v0: Tagged data, stacks, integer equality, branch and fixed field access can encode a smaller cons-list checker within its 128-instruction/16-register limits; no instruction absence blocks the finite question
language_audit.selected: Existing v1: Length, FieldDynamic, StackLength and Pack make finite token-sequence construction and comparison explicit. Equal compares integers only; the Adva program loops over tokens.

encoding.input: Node(10, [Node(11, integer label IDs), expected expression])
encoding.expression: Node(1, [integer typecode, Node(2, integer token IDs)])
encoding.context: fp and fq are active. fr was an earlier closed-block floating hypothesis wff q, closed before fq was introduced; thus using fr has exactly the same substitution/type as fq but an inactive label. Only the listed proof labels are supported; earlier assertions remain usable after a block closes. The substitution variable p is mandatory in each ax/neg/dup frame.

protected: No hidden Python/Rust proof-checking callback or program-selected host oracle
Preserve input, complete bytecode, native transition trace and fresh native replay receipt
Independently replay each native state digest using the inherited Python v1 instruction reference
Explicit Rejected differs from FuelExhausted and Suspended; resource bounds do not establish logical invalidity
No automatic fuel refill; continuation must preserve the original program/input/fuel and complete trace
The independent Metamath tool checks original toy fixtures only, with no set.mm import or third-party source vendoring

external_checker.acceptance: Exit zero, explicit verification summary, and no ?Error or incomplete-proof warning. Exit zero alone is insufficient.

exit: Stop the finite invocation on the first mismatch or resource limit, retain its failure report, and do not retry automatically. Regressions use a fresh directory. A successful run establishes only this frozen database and fixture family.
residual: General .mm parsing, database admission, dynamic/nested scope, $e/$d, arbitrary assertion frames, multi-variable substitution, compressed proof and generic proof capability remain open. The toy axiom |- p is deliberately not a claim of propositional soundness. No PSC0 diagram/source/graft certificate, native Seal or completed Issue #29 is asserted.
